credentialRequirements.description: Plain API key supplied only within the credential adapter and scoped to the intended workspace with least-privileged permissions. The reusable API key and customer data must never be returned outside the authorized action result.

add_customer_to_groups.description: Add a customer to one or more groups

group_ids.description: Customer group IDs to add customer to

add_labels.description: Add labels to a thread. Takes label TYPE ids (lt_…) from list_label_types. Labels already on the thread (see get_thread) don't need re-adding.

assign_thread.description: Assign a thread to a user

user_id.description: The user ID to assign to

change_thread_priority.description: Change the priority of a thread

change_thread_status_to_todo.description: Change thread status to Todo with optional status detail. Use this instead of mark_thread_todo when you need to set a specific status detail.

status_detail.description: Status detail: CREATED (Needs first response), IN_PROGRESS (Investigating), NEW_REPLY (Needs next response), THREAD_LINK_UPDATED (Close the loop), THREAD_DISCUSSION_RESOLVED (Discussion resolved)

create_customer_event.description: Create a custom event on a customer timeline

public_name.description: Public-facing name of the help center

internal_name.description: Internal name for the help center

subdomain.description: Subdomain for the help center (e.g., 'help' for help.plain.com)

create_help_center_article_group.description: Create a new article group (category) in a help center

parent_id.description: Parent group ID for nested groups

create_knowledge_source.description: Create a knowledge source for AI to reference

create_note.description: Create an internal note on a thread (not visible to customer)

thread_id.description: The thread ID to add the note to

customer_id.description: The customer ID associated with the thread

text.description: The note content. Rendered as markdown, so you can use headings, lists, and blockquotes. To embed a copy-paste-ready draft reply, format it as a blockquote (prefix every line with '> ', including blank lines between paragraphs) so it renders as one quoted block and keeps its line breaks when copied.

markdown.description: Optional explicit markdown override; defaults to `text`

create_thread.description: Create a new support thread for a customer

create_thread_event.description: Create a custom event on a thread timeline

help_center_id.description: The help center ID to delete

group_id.description: The article group ID to delete

knowledge_source_id.description: The knowledge source ID to delete

delete_note.description: Delete an internal note from a thread

webhook_id.description: The webhook target ID to delete

download_attachment.description: Download a thread attachment (attachment IDs appear in get_thread timeline entries) to a local temp file and return its path. Images (customer screenshots/recordings thumbnails) can then be viewed with the Read tool.

attachment_id.description: The attachment ID from a timeline entry

generate_help_center_article.description: Auto-generate a help center article from a support thread using AI

thread_id.description: The thread ID to generate article from

help_center_id.description: The help center ID to create the article in

get_customer.description: Get detailed customer information by ID

get_help_center.description: Get details of a specific help center

get_help_center_article.description: Get a specific help center article by ID

get_help_center_article_by_slug.description: Get a help center article by its URL slug

get_help_center_article_group.description: Get a specific article group by ID

get_help_center_index.description: Get the navigation index/structure of a help center

get_queue_stats.description: Get a quick overview of the support queue with counts by status

get_thread.description: Get detailed thread information including conversation timeline

link_thread_to_linear.description: Link a Plain support thread to a Linear issue for tracking

thread_id.description: The Plain thread ID to link

linear_issue_id.description: The Linear issue ID (e.g., 'TEL-123' or the UUID)

list_help_center_article_groups.description: List article groups (categories) in a help center

list_help_center_articles.description: List articles in a help center

list_help_centers.description: List all help centers in the workspace

limit.description: Number of help centers to return

list_label_types.description: List the workspace's active label types — the label kinds that can be applied to threads with add_labels. Returns id (lt_…), name, icon.

list_thread_field_schemas.description: List all custom thread field schemas

list_threads.description: List support threads with optional filters. Note: statusDetail (CREATED, NEW_REPLY, etc.) is not available in list results - use get_thread for that.

customer_id.description: The customer ID to mark as spam

mark_thread_done.description: Mark a support thread as done/resolved

thread_id.description: The thread ID to mark as done

mark_thread_todo.description: Mark a support thread as todo (re-open it)

thread_id.description: The thread ID to mark as todo

remove_customer_from_groups.description: Remove a customer from one or more groups

group_ids.description: Customer group IDs to remove customer from

remove_labels.description: Remove labels from a thread. Takes label INSTANCE ids (l_…, the `id` field of get_thread's labels) — NOT label type ids.

label_ids.description: Label instance ids (l_…) from get_thread's labels array

reply_to_thread.description: Reply to a support thread. The reply will be sent to the customer via the original channel (email, chat, etc.)

thread_id.description: The thread ID to reply to

text.description: The plain text content of the reply

markdown.description: Optional markdown-formatted content (will be used for rich display if supported)

send_chat.description: Send a chat message to a customer

send_email.description: Send a new email to a customer (starts a new thread)

snooze_thread.description: Snooze a support thread. Use WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER (no duration) to snooze until customer replies, or WAITING_FOR_DURATION with duration_seconds for time-based snooze.

duration_seconds.description: Duration to snooze in seconds. Required for WAITING_FOR_DURATION, omit for WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER.

status_detail.description: WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER: snooze until customer replies (no duration). WAITING_FOR_DURATION: snooze for specified duration.

unmark_customer_as_spam.description: Remove spam marking from a customer

customer_id.description: The customer ID to unmark as spam

help_center_id.description: The help center ID to update

group_id.description: The article group ID to update

update_help_center_custom_domain.description: Set a custom domain for a help center

custom_domain_name.description: The custom domain name (e.g., 'help.example.com') or null to remove

update_help_center_index.description: Update the navigation index/structure of a help center

hash.description: Current hash from get_help_center_index (for optimistic locking)

update_thread_title.description: Update the title of a thread

event_types.description: New event types to subscribe to

external_id.description: External system ID for the customer

upsert_help_center_article.description: Create or update a help center article

article_id.description: Article ID to update (omit to create new)

group_id.description: Article group ID to place article in

upsert_thread_field.description: Set a custom field value on a thread

key.description: Field key (must match a thread field schema key)

verify_help_center_custom_domain.description: Verify DNS ownership of a custom domain for a help center
